article_title: Job ghosting: What applicants can do if employers do not respond
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level B; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What central problem does the article examine?
options: Employers refusing to advertise vacancies
Universities ending marketing degrees
Job applicants being ignored without responses or useful feedback
Young people declining all interview offers
tasks.correct_answer: Job applicants being ignored without responses or useful feedback
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת ב־job ghosting: מועמדים שאינם מקבלים תשובה או משוב ממעסיקים.

tasks.prompt: What did Alan Milburn recommend large employers do?
options: Interview every applicant under 25
Stop using online applications
Give meaningful feedback to all unsuccessful applicants under 25
Hire only people who are not in education
tasks.correct_answer: Give meaningful feedback to all unsuccessful applicants under 25
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מילברן הציע שמעסיקים גדולים ייתנו משוב משמעותי לכל מועמד מתחת לגיל 25 שלא התקבל.

tasks.prompt: What did research by Robert Walters find?
options: Half of employers had stopped recruiting
86% of UK job hunters said an application had been ignored with no response
Most applicants received detailed interview notes
Only graduates experienced job ghosting
tasks.correct_answer: 86% of UK job hunters said an application had been ignored with no response
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקר מצא ש־86% ממחפשי העבודה בבריטניה דיווחו שבקשות שלהם נענו בשתיקה.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does the phrase “wall of silence” suggest?
options: A legal ban on speaking at interviews
A quiet office building
A short pause before a decision
A persistent lack of communication that gives applicants nothing to learn from
tasks.correct_answer: A persistent lack of communication that gives applicants nothing to learn from
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר היעדר מתמשך של תגובה מצד המעסיקים, כך שלמועמדים אין ממה ללמוד.

tasks.prompt: What practical advice does career coach Meg Burton give applicants?
options: Tailor each CV to the job instead of sending many identical applications
Use AI to submit as many identical applications as possible
Avoid applying for roles with interviews
Take every unanswered application personally
tasks.correct_answer: Tailor each CV to the job instead of sending many identical applications
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברטון ממליצה להתאים את קורות החיים לכל משרה ולא לשלוח מאות בקשות זהות.

tasks.prompt: Why might AI make job ghosting worse, according to the article?
options: AI prevents companies from reading CVs
AI removes all graduate vacancies
AI helps candidates send very large numbers of applications, increasing employers' workload
AI automatically rejects every applicant under 25
tasks.correct_answer: AI helps candidates send very large numbers of applications, increasing employers' workload
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה ש־AI מאפשר לשלוח מספר עצום של בקשות, ולכן מעסיקים מוצפים וקשה להם להשיב לכולן.

tasks.prompt: Compare the experiences of Yugraj Samrai and Ffion Johns.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שיוגראג' שלח מאות בקשות ולא קיבל תשובה ב־30–40% מהמקרים, ואילו פיון שלחה 70 בקשות לפני ראיון ראשון וגם נותרה ללא תשובה אחרי ראיונות.
expected_points: Yugraj submitted hundreds of applications and heard nothing 30–40% of the time.
Ffion submitted 70 applications before getting an interview.
Ffion also experienced silence after interviews and wanted feedback to improve.

tasks.prompt: Why does constructive feedback matter to the young applicants quoted in the article?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שמשוב מכיר בזמן ובמאמץ שהושקעו, מאפשר לזהות בעיות ולשפר בקשות עתידיות, ומפחית תחושת חוסר אנושיות.
expected_points: It recognises the time and emotional effort applicants invest.
It tells them what went wrong and what they can improve.
It can reduce the feeling of being treated like a statistic rather than a person.

tasks.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences evaluating whether employers should respond differently after an application and after an interview.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין הודעת דחייה בסיסית לכל מועמד לבין משוב מפורט יותר למי שהגיע לראיון, ולהתייחס לעומס הבקשות.
expected_points: All applicants should at least receive a clear success or rejection message.
Interviewed candidates should receive specific pointers because they invested more time.
Employers face high application volumes, so detailed feedback for every initial application may be difficult.
Automation or AI could help send basic responses without replacing thoughtful interview feedback.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the causes, effects and proposed responses to job ghosting in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול עומס בקשות ושימוש ב־AI, פגיעה בביטחון המועמדים, המלצת מילברן, עצות ברטון למעסיקים ולמועמדים.
expected_points: Competitive recruitment and AI-assisted mass applications can overwhelm employers.
Silence leaves applicants demoralised and unable to learn from rejection.
Milburn proposed meaningful feedback for unsuccessful applicants under 25 at large employers.
Career advisers say firms should at least notify candidates and give interview feedback.
Applicants can tailor their CVs and avoid taking silence as a judgment of their worth.
